text:
Sentence 1: Tell me what the fastest land animal in the world is.

- Tell: Verb (Imperative)
- me: Pronoun (Object)
- what: Pronoun (Interrogative/Relative)
- the: Determiner
- fastest: Adjective (Superlative)
- land: Noun (Attributive)
- animal: Noun
- in: Preposition
- the: Determiner
- world: Noun
- is: Verb (Linking)

Sentence 2: While I was walking through the park, I stumbled upon an old, mysterious book that was hidden beneath a pile of leaves.

- While: Conjunction (Subordinating)
- I: Pronoun (Subject)
- was: Verb (Auxiliary)
- walking: Verb (Present Participle)
- through: Preposition
- the: Determiner
- park: Noun
- I: Pronoun (Subject)
- stumbled: Verb
- upon: Preposition
- an: Determiner
- old: Adjective
- mysterious: Adjective
- book: Noun
- that: Pronoun (Relative)
- was: Verb (Auxiliary)
- hidden: Verb (Past Participle)
- beneath: Preposition
- a: Determiner
- pile: Noun
- of: Preposition
- leaves: Noun
